pages.title: What is Nourished?
pages.text: Nourished adds a lightweight nutrition system to Minecraft that rewards dietary variety with meaningful gameplay benefits.$(br2)Eat a wide variety of foods, maintain a balanced diet, and gain passive bonuses over time. Neglect entire food groups and your nutrition will slowly work against you.

pages.title: Six Food Groups
pages.text: Nourished tracks six core dietary groups:$(br2)$(li)Fruits$(li)Vegetables$(li)Proteins$(li)Grains$(li)Sugars$(li)Dairy$(br2)Every food you eat contributes to one or more of these groups. Your goal is to keep all six balanced.
